title: H167 — The Rupert Toroid Engine
proposed_geometry: two opposing Rupert-like heads p,d each with tail entering central mediator o, with head outlets p+ and d- after triggered fracture
orientation: I-shaped POD; opposing exits redirected tangentially at +R and -R
engine_cycle: nozzle guides impulse through p+ and d-

mechanics.torque_sum: +2RF if both act on the same rotor
mechanics.counterreaction: housing receives equal opposite angular and linear momentum
mechanics.stored_fuel_update: E'=E-(K_new-K_old), refuse pulse if insufficient energy

limitations: Prince Rupert heads break under rapid cracking but do not inherently form controlled nozzles
Internal exhaust must couple to a rotor; otherwise it spins the fluid only
Net total angular momentum is conserved, a free isolated rotor must counter-rotate its environment
Finite stored energy, no perpetual engine
No physical Planck bubble or cosmology validation
